notes.title: Update December 2020
notes.content:
The protectors of deya, update December 2020.

- Skill cost balance revisited and fixed.
- Some translate dialogue improve.
- Fixed a bug where some combat can cause crash.
- Mini tutorial for help to understand various game element.
- Fixed NPC who randomly block terrain walks.

Thank you all for playing.

notes.title: The protectors of Deya - Release 1.1
notes.content:
[h1] General Info: Update 1.1 [/h1] 

With the release of the 1.1 version of the game, the protectors of Deya has added a new zone. 

The [b]Floating Temple[/b], with new rewards, seasonal rewards and a complete new dungeon to explore for all the players. Make sure to be at least level 10 if you would like to explore it. 

[h1] New Feature [/h1] 

[b]Minions zone[/b] added. What is the minions zone? 
Grow up your minions, give them food, see them grows and maybe one day they will destroy the world!
